outcome_analysis: Ekpa is a Summer 2026 company with no outcome yet. The YC page frames it as autonomous trading research agents while the live site describes a read-only portfolio research and education tool that cannot place trades, so the product is narrower than the pitch. Competition from funded agent trading startups is dense and the traction claim of 7M connected assets is self reported.
notes: Dealroom lists 125k seed, single aggregator, unverified. Site claims 7M+ connected assets and 6,500 analyses, self reported.
